title: Airbus H125 (Asobo)

Checked on the running helicopter, MSFS 2024, 2026-11-26 (parked; read back with the simulation variables named in each note)

entries.name: ROTOR_BRAKE
entries.note: Verified on the H125 in MSFS 2024 (2026-11-26): takes 0 to 1: 1 = brake on ((A:ROTOR BRAKE ACTIVE) = 1), 0 = off. Cold and dark is 1; the autostart releases it.

entries.name: PROCEDURE_STANDALONE_AUTO_START_SHUTDOWN
entries.note: Verified on the H125 in MSFS 2024 (2026-11-26): one event starts the engine by the sim's own procedure (rotor at 100 % in about 65 s). A second event did NOT shut it down: stop the engine with the starting selector.

entries.name: ENGINE_STARTER
entries.note: Verified on the H125 in MSFS 2024 (2026-11-26): the starting selector: 1 = ON (with its guard up, COMMON_ENGINE_STARTER_COVER = 0) starts the engine (the FADEC runs the start); 0 = OFF stops the engine, and the selector goes to OFF only with the guard down (cover 1), as the sim's checklist says: "Set starting selector on Off with switch guard down".

entries.name: COMMON_ENGINE_STARTER_COVER
entries.note: Verified on the H125 in MSFS 2024 (2026-11-26): the guard over the starting selector: 0 = up (the sim's autostart leaves it there), 1 = down. The selector goes to OFF only with the guard down.

entries.name: ENGINE_THROTTLE_TWIST
entries.note: Verified on the H125 in MSFS 2024 (2026-11-26): two positions: 0 = IDLE, 1 = FLIGHT (0.5 stays where it was). The FADEC sets the fuel: AXIS_HELICOPTER_THROTTLE_SET does nothing here. At IDLE N1 falls to about 50 %, the rotor to about 93 %.
